description: Defines data classes for sharing updates and attributes in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including UpdateShareRequest and ShareAttributes variants.

classes.name: UpdateShareRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to update a share, including share ID, permissions, password, public upload flag, expiration date, note, attributes, and send mail flag.

classes.name: ShareAttributesV2
classes.description: Data class for share attributes with scope, key, and boolean value.

classes.name: ShareAttributesV1
classes.description: Data class for share attributes with scope, key, and enabled boolean flag.
